subject: DPiA evidence sprint: tokenization details, retention matrix, Art.30 ledger
messages:
From: Ari Collins <ari.collins@novamed.health>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Geller <lauren.geller@novamed.health>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: DPiA evidence & tokenization approach

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our internal DPIA and procurement checklist we need a short evidence package to validate processing controls for Novamed's PHI-adjacent workloads. Specifically we need: 

- A concise description of tokenization/pseudonymization approach for text inputs (how/where tokens are stored, KMS usage, and whether tokens are reversible).
- Retention matrix showing default retention by data class and how retention deletes are executed.
- An export of the Article 30 ledger (recent snapshot is fine) or instructions to generate it.
- Any existing sampling plan you can share (how you surface examples for DPIA reviewers).

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA for the materials? We have a DPIA review window starting 2026-07-27 and ideally need the package by 2026-07-23. If some items require an NDA/data room, let us know and we can route.

Appreciate it —
Ari

Ari Collins
Security & Privacy Lead
Novamed Health
ari.collins@novamed.health
+1 415 555 0132
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: DPiA evidence & tokenization approach

Forwarding Novamed's request — Ari has a DPIA review window starting 7/27 and needs evidence by 7/23. Short ask; priority: tokenization spec, retention matrix, and an Article 30 ledger snapshot.

Marissa — can you own the package and confirm whether we need any special exports from infra?
Irene — can you confirm sampling/ops playbook excerpt we can share (we should redact customer-specific lines).
Marcus — please confirm where the Article 30 ledger export lives and if we can provide a CSV snapshot.

If possible, include a brief README that explains each file and any manual steps. If anything requires an NDAs or a redaction pass, flag here.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Ari Collins <ari.collins@novamed.health>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPiA evidence & tokenization approach

Hi all —

Thanks for the clear asks, Ari. Quick status and plan: 

1) Tokenization spec (tokenization_spec.xlsx) — owner: Marissa. I will attach a one-page spec describing:
   - token creation flow (client-side / proxy / runtime)
   - where derived tokens are stored (KV cache vs persistent blobstore)
   - KMS keys used for envelope encryption and rotation cadence
   - reversibility policy (we treat these as reversible under controlled HSM-wrapped keys; disclosure controls in place)

2) Retention matrix (retention_matrix_v1.csv) — owner: Irene. Contains data class columns, default retention, and deletion mechanism (API/async job). Will include instructions for bulk erase requests and expected SLAs.

3) Article 30 ledger export (article30_ledger_export_20260720.csv) — owner: Marcus. We can produce a CSV snapshot with processing activities, subprocessors, and legal basis. Marcus, can you confirm the export includes subprocessor host region column? Novamed requested cross-border context.

4) Sampling plan excerpt — owner: Irene. We'll redact PII examples and include the sampling criteria and size.

Deliverables and ETA: we can assemble a redacted package (README + three files) by 2026-07-22 EOD. The full unredacted ledger will require an internal approval and can be made available in the secure drive the next day (2026-07-23). If Novamed needs the unredacted ledger earlier we can route through an NDA/data room.

Attachments referenced: tokenization_spec.xlsx (stub), retention_matrix_v1.csv (stub), article30_ledger_export_20260720.csv (stub).

Let me know if the redaction level is acceptable — we will keep the redacted package to non-production-identifying metadata.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Privacy Analyst
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Ari Collins <ari.collins@novamed.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Geller <lauren.geller@novamed.health>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPiA evidence & tokenization approach

Marissa (and team) —

This is great, thanks for the quick turnaround and clear plan. Redacted package by 7/22 EOD is fine for the DPIA intake. We do want the Article 30 ledger to include a column for "host_region" and a note on subprocessors that process data outside the EEA — if you can flag those rows that would help our legal team.

We'd also like to set a 30-minute follow-up call on 2026-07-23 to walk through the CSV and ask any clarifying questions. Sofia or Marissa, can you propose times? 

Thanks again — much appreciated.

Ari
